nodes.label: client.js
nodes.description: Client-side plugin bundle (lib/client.js) rendering the settings panel card and driving the periodic GUI session-list refresh.

nodes.label: ValueField()
nodes.description: ValueField(): reusable labeled input row component used by LifecycleCard for numeric config fields.

nodes.label: LifecycleCard()
nodes.description: LifecycleCard(): the settings panel card component rendering all nine config fields with save/discard and hot-reload wiring.

nodes.label: apply()
nodes.description: client apply(): registers the settings.plugin.item slot with the LifecycleCard and starts the periodic refreshList timer.

nodes.label: index.js
nodes.description: Host-side plugin entry (lib/index.js) implementing session scanning, archiving, pruning, and the settings panel schema.

nodes.label: execFileAsync
nodes.description: execFileAsync: promisified execFile wrapper used to invoke the system zstd binary for log decompression.

nodes.label: inject
nodes.description: inject: the plugin's declared host service dependencies (timer, storageDomain).

nodes.label: NS
nodes.description: NS: the settings namespace key 'session-lifecycle' pairing the host Config section with the client card.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.description: Config: schemastery object schema for the plugin's nine settings-panel configuration fields.

nodes.label: SESSIONS_ROOT
nodes.description: SESSIONS_ROOT: constant path to the live sessions directory under DSH_HOME.

nodes.label: ARCHIVE_ROOT
nodes.description: ARCHIVE_ROOT: constant path to ~/.dsh/sessions-archive where archived session directories are moved.

nodes.label: runtime
nodes.description: runtime: module-level mutable state holding config-derived values (interval, caps, idle days, archive mode).

nodes.label: priority()
nodes.description: priority(): cleanup ordering score — one-shot 0, continuable 1, main 2 — used by the capacity-cap sort.

nodes.label: decompressLog()
nodes.description: decompressLog(): decompresses a multi-frame zstd session log via the system zstd CLI, falling back to plain text.

nodes.label: decodeSession()
nodes.description: decodeSession(): parses a session log text to extract origin (main/subagent), mode (one-shot/continuable), and ended flags.

nodes.label: scanSessions()
nodes.description: scanSessions(): walks the sessions directory tree, decompresses each zstd log, and decodes origin/mode/ended metadata.

nodes.label: archiveSession()
nodes.description: archiveSession(): moves a session directory into the archive, purges its projcache row, and detaches it from workspace accounting.

nodes.label: pruneArchive()
nodes.description: pruneArchive(): physically deletes archive-directory sessions whose mtime is older than the configured archiveHours cutoff.

nodes.label: runOnce()
nodes.description: runOnce(): main prune pipeline combining one-shot cleanup, idle-day archiving, and capacity-cap recycling in one scan.

nodes.label: apply()
nodes.description: host apply(): installs the settings section, wires onChange hot reload, and arms the initial scan plus interval timer.

nodes.label: dry-run.js
nodes.description: Read-only dry-run test that scans the current session library and reports classification stats without deleting anything.

nodes.label: execFileAsync
nodes.description: dry-run's promisified execFile binding for zstd decompression during the read-only scan.

nodes.label: SESSIONS_ROOT
nodes.description: dry-run's SESSIONS_ROOT: the sessions directory path the read-only scanner walks.

nodes.label: decompressLog()
nodes.description: dry-run's copy of decompressLog(): decompresses a session log via the zstd CLI with a plain-text fallback.

nodes.label: decodeSession()
nodes.description: dry-run's decodeSession(): classifies one scanned log as main/one-shot/continuable and whether it ended.

nodes.label: stats
nodes.description: stats: dry-run.js classification counters (main / one-shot / continuable / unknown).

nodes.label: noEnd
nodes.description: noEnd: array in dry-run.js of session id prefixes still lacking session/end-seed (protected running sessions).

nodes.label: errs
nodes.description: errs: array in dry-run.js collecting session ids whose logs failed to decompress or parse.

nodes.label: e2e.js
nodes.description: Isolated end-to-end test that builds a fake one-shot session in a temp DSH_HOME, runs runOnce(), and asserts it gets archived.

nodes.label: TEST_DIR
nodes.description: TEST_DIR: the temp DSH_HOME session directory the e2e test creates for the fake one-shot session.

nodes.label: now
nodes.description: now: current timestamp used by the e2e fixture to build the fake session's header and events.

nodes.label: lines
nodes.description: lines: the fake session log lines (header + descriptor + end-seed) the e2e test writes and zstd-compresses.

nodes.label: plainPath
nodes.description: plainPath: temporary plaintext JSONL path in the e2e fixture, compressed to session.jsonl.zstd then removed.

nodes.label: hit
nodes.description: hit: the scanned session entry the e2e test looks up to assert one-shot recognition succeeded.

nodes.label: mockCtx
nodes.description: mockCtx: minimal context stub passed to runOnce() in e2e, providing a storageDomain whose get() returns undefined.

nodes.label: dsh-session-pruner README
nodes.description: dsh-session-pruner README: English overview of the plugin's strategy, configuration table, and environment variables.

nodes.label: dsh-session-pruner 中文说明
nodes.description: dsh-session-pruner Chinese README mirroring the English documentation for the plugin.

nodes.label: DSH 插件开发实践指南
nodes.description: Development guide documenting DSH plugin practices: session/end-seed semantics, bundle whitelist registration, and rollback protection.

nodes.label: dsh-session-pruner plugin
nodes.description: The dsh-session-pruner plugin managing DSH session lifecycle: one-shot cleanup, idle archiving, capacity caps, and projection-cache purging.

nodes.label: session_projcache.json
nodes.description: session_projcache.json: the storage-domain projection cache file whose rows are purged for every archived session.

nodes.label: one-shot subagent
nodes.description: one-shot subagent: disposable child agent archived on completion, protected by a configurable minimum-age grace period.

nodes.label: continuable subagent
nodes.description: continuable subagent: resumable child agent archived only after idleDays of inactivity when the option is enabled.

nodes.label: main session
nodes.description: main session: primary conversation sessions, never auto-archived unless capacity is exceeded with cleanMain enabled.

nodes.label: Capacity cap recycling
nodes.description: Capacity cap recycling: when session count exceeds maxSessions, oldest sessions are archived by one-shot → continuable → main priority.

nodes.label: Archive-first recoverable deletion
nodes.description: Recoverable deletion strategy: sessions are first moved into an archive directory, then physically removed after archiveHours.

nodes.label: GUI sync via refreshList
nodes.description: GUI sync via refreshList: the client periodically calls sessions.refreshList() so archived sessions vanish from the sidebar.

nodes.label: Multi-frame zstd log parsing
nodes.description: Multi-frame zstd log parsing: session logs concatenate multiple zstd frames, so node zlib is bypassed for the zstd CLI.

nodes.label: System zstd CLI dependency
nodes.description: System zstd CLI dependency: the plugin shells out to the zstd binary instead of bundling any npm compression dependency.

nodes.label: projcache row purge
nodes.description: projcache row purge: deleting the session_projcache row for each archived session through the storageDomain write chain.

nodes.label: Settings panel hot reload
nodes.description: Settings panel hot reload: config changes rewrite runtime state and reschedule the scan timer without restarting the host.

nodes.label: session/end-seed semantics
nodes.description: session/end-seed semantics: the log event marking a session as finished; only ended sessions are eligible for archiving.

nodes.label: guard rollback protection
nodes.description: guard rollback protection: recoverable restore path for sessions archived in error, using the plugin's archive log lines.

nodes.label: Bundles whitelist registration
nodes.description: Bundles whitelist registration: the client bundle id must be whitelisted so the module loader accepts it.

nodes.label: Projection cache bloat / event-loop stall
nodes.description: Projection cache bloat / event-loop stall: the failure mode (145MB projcache) the plugin prevents with per-session purge.

nodes.label: ~/.dsh/sessions-archive/ directory
nodes.description: ~/.dsh/sessions-archive/ directory: moved-out sessions live here for archiveHours before physical deletion.

nodes.label: Workspace accounting consistency
nodes.description: Workspace accounting consistency: archived sessions are detached from the workspace record's sessionIds to keep disk and GUI aligned.

nodes.label: Root fix upstream: projcache eviction / incremental writes
nodes.description: Root fix upstream: projcache eviction and incremental writes tracked in deepseek-harness, the plugin's guard against cache bloat.

nodes.label: deepseek-harness Discussion #1550
nodes.description: deepseek-harness Discussion #1550: upstream thread about projcache eviction and incremental writes that grounds the plugin's cache fix.
